title: Taiwanese American Organization at the University of Southern California
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Organization (TAO) at the University of Southern California is a student cultural and social organization founded in 1995. It was established as a club welcoming all USC students regardless of cultural background, with a particular focus on promoting awareness and exploration of Taiwanese and Taiwanese American culture. TAO maintains an official website at usctao.org and a Wix events site, and is a member organization of the USC Asian Pacific American Student Assembly (APASA).

TAO’s programming encompasses social, cultural, and professional events designed to be accessible both to students already familiar with Taiwanese culture and to those encountering it for the first time. The organization emphasizes building a tight-knit, diverse community and providing resources to support members’ broader aspirations. From its earliest months, TAO attracted members from around the world, and that multicultural character has remained central to its identity.

TAO also engages with the broader Taiwanese American student community through participation in the annual Intercollegiate Taiwanese Student Association (ITASA) conference, a national gathering of Taiwanese American student organizations across U.S. universities. This participation reflects TAO’s commitment to fostering leadership and strengthening connections among Taiwanese American students beyond the USC campus.
